0022600146.text: The Trail Blazers (3-0, on a three-game winning streak and first in the Northwest) host the Grizzlies (4-0, on a four-game winning streak and second in the Southwest, half a game back) in a matchup of unbeaten teams. Portland is missing Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), both listed as out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Portland won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, most recently a 122-114 win in Memphis on March 4, 2026.
